verses.content: 基督耶稣的奴仆保罗，蒙召的使徒，被分别出来归于神福音的；
verses.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

verses.content: 这福音是神从前借着祂的众申言者，在圣经上所应许的，
verses.kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

verses.content: 论到祂的儿子，我们的主耶稣基督：按肉体说，是从大卫后裔生的，
verses.kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

verses.content: 按圣别的灵说，是从死人的复活，以大能标出为神的儿子；
verses.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead: declared: Gr. determined

verses.content: 我们借着祂，领受了恩典和使徒的职分，为祂的名在万国中使人顺从信仰，
verses.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name: for obedience...: or, to the obedience of faith

verses.content: 其中也有你们这蒙召属耶稣基督的人；
verses.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

verses.content: 写信给一切在罗马，为神所爱，蒙召的圣徒。愿恩典与平安，从神我们的父，并主耶稣基督归与你们。
verses.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.content: 首先，我借着耶稣基督，为你们众人感谢我的神，因你们的信心传遍了全世界。
verses.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

verses.content: 我在祂儿子的福音上，在我灵里所事奉的神，可以见证我怎样在祷告中，常常不住地提到你们，
verses.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers; with: or, in

verses.content: 祈求神，或许在祂的旨意中，终能顺利地往你们那里去。
verses.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

verses.content: 因为我切切地想见你们，要把些属灵的恩赐分给你们，使你们得以坚固；
verses.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

verses.content: 这样，我在你们中间，因你们与我彼此的信心，就可以同得鼓励。
verses.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me. with: or, in

verses.content: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我屡次定意往你们那里去，要在你们中间也得些果子，如同在其余的外邦人中一样，只是到如今仍有拦阻。
verses.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles. among: or, in

verses.content: 无论对希利尼人还是对化外人，无论对智慧人还是对愚拙人，我都是欠债的。
verses.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

verses.content: 所以在我，我已经预备好，要将福音也传给你们在罗马的人。
verses.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

verses.content: 我不以福音为耻；这福音本是神的大能，要救一切信的人，先是犹太人，后是希利尼人。
verses.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

verses.content: 因为神的义在这福音上，本于信显示与信，如经上所记：“义人必本于信得生并活着。”
verses.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

verses.content: 原来神的忿怒，从天上显示在那些以不义抑制真理之人一切的不虔不义上。
verses.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

verses.content: 因为神的事情，人所能知道的，原显明在人里面，因为神已经给他们显明了。
verses.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them. in them: or, to them

verses.content: 自从创造世界以来，神那看不见永远的大能，和神性的特征，是人所洞见的，乃是借着受造之物，给人晓得的，叫人无法推诿；
verses.kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse: so...: or, that they may be

verses.content: 因为他们虽然知道神，却不当作神荣耀祂，也不感谢祂，反倒在他们的推想上变为虚妄，他们无知的心就昏暗了。
verses.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

verses.content: 他们自称是智慧的，反成了愚拙的，
verses.kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

verses.content: 将不能朽坏之神的荣耀，改换为必朽坏的人、飞禽、走兽和爬物之像的样式。
verses.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

verses.content: 所以神任凭他们逞着心里的情欲，陷入污秽中，以致彼此玷辱自己的身体。
verses.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

verses.content: 他们将神的真实换为虚谎，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬拜事奉那创造者；祂乃是当受颂赞的，直到永远。阿们。
verses.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen. more: or, rather

verses.content: 因此，神任凭他们陷入可耻的情欲：他们的女人把顺性的用处换为逆性的用处；
verses.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

verses.content: 男人也是如此，弃了女人顺性的用处，欲火中烧，彼此贪恋，男和男行可耻的事，就在自己身上受这妄为当得的报应。
verses.kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

verses.content: 他们既然不以认识神为美，神就任凭他们存可弃绝的心思，行那些不合宜的事，
verses.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient; to retain: or, to acknowledge a reprobate...: or, a mind void of judgment or, an unapproving mind

verses.content: 充满了各样不义、邪恶、贪婪、恶毒，满了嫉妒、凶杀、争竞、诡诈、毒恨；
verses.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

verses.content: 又是谗毁人的，背后说人的，憎恨神的，侮慢人的，狂傲的，自夸的，捏造恶事的，违背父母的，
verses.kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

verses.content: 无知的，背约的，无亲情的，无怜悯的。
verses.kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful: without natural...: or unsociable

verses.content: 他们虽明知神公义的判决，行这样事的人是当死的，然而他们不但自己去行，还与那些行这样事的人同欢，以他们为乐。
verses.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them. have...: or, consent with

verses.content: 人哪，每一个审判人的！你是无法推诿的，你在什么事上审判人，就在什么事上定自己的罪；因你这审判人的，也行同样的事。
verses.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

verses.content: 我们知道行这样事的人，神必按真理审判他。
verses.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

verses.content: 人哪，你审判行这样事的人，自己却照样行，你以为能逃脱神的审判么？
verses.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

verses.content: 还是你藐视祂丰富的恩慈、宽容与恒忍，不晓得神的恩慈是领你悔改？
verses.kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

verses.content: 你竟任着你刚硬不悔改的心，为自己在神动怒并显示祂公义审判的日子，积蓄忿怒。
verses.kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

verses.content: 祂必照各人的行为报应各人：
verses.kjv: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

verses.content: 凡恒心行善，寻求荣耀、尊贵和不朽坏的，就以永远的生命报应他们；
verses.kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

verses.content: 惟有私图好争，不信从真理，反信从不义的，就以忿怒、恼恨报应他们；
verses.kjv: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

verses.content: 将患难、困苦加给一切作恶的人，先是犹太人，后是希利尼人；
verses.kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile; Gentile: Gr. Greek

verses.content: 却将荣耀、尊贵与平安加给一切行善的人，先是犹太人，后是希利尼人。
verses.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile: Gentile: Gr. Greek

verses.content: 因为神并不偏待人。
verses.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.

verses.content: 凡在律法以外犯了罪的，也必在律法以外灭亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，必按律法受审判，
verses.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

verses.content: （原来在神面前，不是听律法的为义，乃是行律法的称义。
verses.kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

verses.content: 没有律法的外邦人，若顺着本性行律法上的事，他们虽然没有律法，自己就是自己的律法：
verses.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

verses.content: 他们显出那写在他们心里律法的功用，他们的良心同作见证，并且他们的思想互相控告或者也辩护。）
verses.kjv: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;) their conscience...: or, the conscience witnessing with them the mean...: or, between themselves

verses.content: 就是在神借耶稣基督，照着我的福音，审判人隐秘事的日子。
verses.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

verses.content: 你名为犹太人，又倚靠律法，且指着神夸口，
verses.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

verses.content: 既从律法受了教导，就认识神的旨意，也能鉴赏那更美的事，
verses.kjv: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law; approvest...: or, triest the things that differ

verses.content: 又深信自己是给瞎子领路的，是黑暗中之人的光，
verses.kjv: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

verses.content: 是愚昧人的管教者，是幼稚人的教师，在律法上有知识和真理的规模；
verses.kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

verses.content: 这样，你这教导别人的，不教导自己么？你这传讲不可偷窃的，自己偷窃么？
verses.kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

verses.content: 你这说不可奸淫的，自己奸淫么？你这憎恶偶像的，自己抢劫庙宇么？
verses.kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

verses.content: 你指着律法夸口，自己却犯律法玷辱神么？
verses.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

verses.content: 如经上所记：“神的名在外邦人中，因你们受了亵渎。”
verses.kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

verses.content: 你若行律法，割礼固然于你有益；但你若是犯律法的，你的割礼就不算割礼。
verses.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

verses.content: 所以那未受割礼的，若遵守律法的典章，他虽然未受割礼，岂不算是受割礼的么？
verses.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

verses.content: 而且那本来未受割礼的，若全守律法，就要审判你这有字句和割礼却犯律法的人。
verses.kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

verses.content: 因为外表上作犹太人的，并不是犹太人；外表上肉体的割礼，也不是割礼。
verses.kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

verses.content: 惟有在内里作的，才是犹太人；割礼也是心里的，在于灵，不在于字句。这人的称赞，不是从人来的，乃是从神来的。
verses.kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

verses.content: 这样，犹太人有什么长处？割礼有什么益处？
verses.kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

verses.content: 各方面都很多。第一，是神的谕言信托了他们。
verses.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

verses.content: 即便有不信的，这有何妨？难道他们的不信，就废掉神的信么？
verses.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

verses.content: 绝对不能！神总是真实的，人都是虚谎的，如经上所记：“好叫你说话的时候，显为公义；被人审判的时候，可以得胜。”
verses.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

verses.content: 我且照着人的常话说，我们的不义若显出神的义来，我们要说什么？神降怒，难道是祂不义么？
verses.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

verses.content: 绝对不是！若是这样，神怎能审判世界？
verses.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

verses.content: 但神的真实，若因我的虚谎，越发洋溢出祂的荣耀，为什么我还受审判像罪人一样？
verses.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

verses.content: 为什么不说，让我们作恶以成善？这是我们所受的毁谤，也是有些人硬说我们有这话。这等人受审判,是该当的。
verses.kjv: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

verses.content: 这却怎么样？我们比他们强么？绝对没有！因我们已经指控，犹太人和希利尼人都在罪之下，
verses.kjv: What then? are we better than they ? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin; proved: Gr. charged

verses.content: 就如经上所记：“没有义人，连一个也没有，
verses.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

verses.content: 没有明白的，没有寻求神的；
verses.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

verses.content: 都是偏离正路，一同变为无用；没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.content: 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓，他们用舌头弄诡诈，嘴唇里有虺蛇的毒气，
verses.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

verses.content: 他们满口是咒骂苦毒；
verses.kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

verses.content: 杀人流血，他们的脚飞跑，
verses.kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

verses.content: 在他们所经过的路上，遍行毁坏和祸害，
verses.kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

verses.content: 平安的路，他们未曾知道；
verses.kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:

verses.content: 他们眼中不怕神。”
verses.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

verses.content: 我们晓得律法上的话，都是对律法以下之人说的，好堵住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在神的审判之下。
verses.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God. guilty...: or, subject to the judgment of God

verses.content: 因为凡属肉体的人，都不能本于行律法在神面前得称义，因为律法本是叫人知罪。
verses.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

verses.content: 但如今神的义在律法以外已经显明出来，有律法和申言者为证，
verses.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

verses.content: 就是神的义，借着信耶稣基督，归与一切信的人，并没有分别。
verses.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

verses.content: 因为众人都犯了罪，亏缺了神的荣耀，
verses.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

verses.content: 但因神的恩典，借着在基督耶稣里的救赎，就白白地得称义。
verses.kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

verses.content: 神摆出基督耶稣作平息处，是凭着祂的血，借着人的信，为要在神以宽容越过人先时所犯的罪上，显示祂的义；
verses.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God; set forth: or, foreordained remission: or, passing over

verses.content: 为着在今时显示祂的义，使祂能是义的，也能称那以信耶稣为本的人为义。
verses.kjv: To declare, I say , at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

verses.content: 既是这样，哪里有可夸的？完全没有了！借着什么律？借着行的律么？不是，乃是借着信的律。
verses.kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

verses.content: 因为我们算定了，人得称义是借着信，与行律法无关。
verses.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

verses.content: 难道神只是犹太人的神么？不也是外邦人的么？是的，也是外邦人的；
verses.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

verses.content: 神既是一位，祂就要本于信称那受割礼的为义，也要借着信称那未受割礼的为义。
verses.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

verses.content: 这样，我们借着信使律法失效么？绝对不是！反而坚固了律法。
verses.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

verses.content: 这样，我们可说我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕照着肉体得了什么？
verses.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

verses.content: 倘若亚伯拉罕是本于行为得称义，就有可夸的，只是在神面前并无可夸。
verses.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

verses.content: 原来经上说什么？说，“亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。”
verses.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

verses.content: 作工的得工价，不是照着恩典，乃是照着所该得者算的。
verses.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

verses.content: 惟有不作工，只信靠那称不虔者为义之神的，他的信就算为他的义。
verses.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

verses.content: 正如大卫也称那在行为以外，蒙神算为义的人为有福的：
verses.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

verses.content: “不法得赦免，罪得遮盖的人，是有福的。
verses.kjv: Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

verses.content: 主绝不算为有罪的人，是有福的。”
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

verses.content: 如此，这称为有福的福是单加给受割礼的人，还是也加给未受割礼的人？因我们说，亚伯拉罕的信，就算为他的义，
verses.kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

verses.content: 是怎么算的？是在他受割礼的时候，还是在他未受割礼的时候？不是在受割礼的时候，乃是在未受割礼的时候。
verses.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

verses.content: 并且他受了割礼的记号，作他未受割礼时那信之义的印记，叫他作一切未受割礼而信之人的父，使他们也算为义；
verses.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

verses.content: 又作受割礼之人的父，就是那些不但受割礼，并且照我们祖宗亚伯拉罕，未受割礼时之信的脚踪而行的人。
verses.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

verses.content: 因为神应许亚伯拉罕，或他的后裔，必得承受世界，不是借着律法，乃是借着信的义。
verses.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.content: 若是本于律法的，才得为后嗣，信就成了虚空，应许也就失效了。
verses.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

verses.content: 因为律法是惹动忿怒的；哪里没有律法，哪里就没有过犯。
verses.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

verses.content: 所以人得为后嗣是本于信，为要照着恩，使应许定然归给一切后裔，不但归给那本于律法的，也归给那本于亚伯拉罕之信的。
verses.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

verses.content: 亚伯拉罕在他所信那叫死人复活，又称无为有的神面前，是我们众人的父，如经上所记：“我已经立你作多国的父。”
verses.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were. before him: or, like unto him

verses.content: 他在无可指望的时候，仍靠指望而信，就得以照先前所说，“你的后裔将要如此”的话，作多国的父。
verses.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

verses.content: 他将近百岁的时候，虽然想到自己的身体如同已死，撒拉的生育也已断绝，他的信还是不软弱，
verses.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

verses.content: 总没有因不信而疑惑神的应许，反倒因信得着加力，将荣耀归与神，
verses.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

verses.content: 且满心确信，神所应许的，祂也必能作成；
verses.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

verses.content: 所以这就算为他的义。
verses.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

verses.content: 算为他的义这句话，不是单为他写的，
verses.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

verses.content: 也是为我们将来得算为义的人，就是为我们这些信靠那使我们的主耶稣从死人中复活者的人写的。
verses.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

verses.content: 耶稣被交给人是为我们的过犯，复活是为我们的称义。
verses.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

verses.content: 所以，我们既本于信得称义，就借着我们的主耶稣基督，对神有了和平。
verses.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.content: 我们又借着祂，因信得进入现在所站的这恩典中，并且因盼望神的荣耀而夸耀。
verses.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

verses.content: 不但如此，就是在患难中，我们也是夸耀，因为知道患难生忍耐，
verses.kjv: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

verses.content: 忍耐生老练，老练生盼望，
verses.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

verses.content: 盼望不至于蒙羞；因为神的爱已经借着所赐给我们的圣灵，浇灌在我们心里。
verses.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

verses.content: 因我们还软弱的时候，基督就照所定的时期为不虔者死了。
verses.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly. in due time: or, according to the time

verses.content: 为义人死，是少有的；为仁人死，或者有敢作的；
verses.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

verses.content: 惟有基督在我们还作罪人的时候，为我们死，神就在此将祂自己的爱向我们显明了。
verses.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.content: 现在我们既因祂的血得称义，就更要借着祂得救脱离忿怒。
verses.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

verses.content: 因为我们作仇敌的时候，且借着神儿子的死得与神和好，既已和好，就更要在祂的生命里得救了。
verses.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

verses.content: 不但如此，我们现今既借着我们的主耶稣基督，得与神和好，也就要借着祂，在神里面夸耀着，在祂的生命里得救了。
verses.kjv: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement. atonement: or, reconciliation

verses.content: 这就如罪是借着一人入了世界，死又是借着罪来的，于是死就遍及众人，因为众人都犯了罪。
verses.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned: for that: or, in whom

verses.content: 没有律法之先，罪已经在世上；但没有律法，罪也不算在账上。
verses.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

verses.content: 然而从亚当到摩西，死就作了王，连那些不照亚当过犯样式犯罪的，也在它的权下；亚当乃是那以后要来者的预像。
verses.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

verses.content: 只是过犯不如恩赐；若因一人的过犯，多人都死了，神的恩典，与耶稣基督一人恩典中白白的恩赐，就更加洋溢地临到多人。
verses.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

verses.content: 并且一人犯罪的结果，也不如白白的恩赐；因为审判是由于一次过犯而定罪，恩赐乃是由于许多过犯而称义。
verses.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

verses.content: 若因一人的过犯，死就借着这一人作了王，那些受洋溢之恩，并洋溢之义恩赐的，就更要借着耶稣基督一人，在生命中作王了。
verses.kjv: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.) by one man's...: or, by one offence

verses.content: 如此说来，借着一次的过犯，众人都被定罪，照样，借着一次的义行，众人也都被称义得生命了。
verses.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life. by the offence...: or, by one offence by the righteousness...: or, by one righteousness

verses.content: 借着一人的悖逆，多人构成了罪人，照样，借着一人的顺从，多人也要构成义的了。
verses.kjv: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

verses.content: 律法插进来，是叫过犯增多，只是罪在哪里增多，恩典就更洋溢了，
verses.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

verses.content: 使罪怎样在死中作王，恩典也照样借着义作王，叫人借着我们的主耶稣基督得永远的生命。
verses.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.content: 这样，我们可说什么？我们可以仍留在罪中，叫恩典增多么？
verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

verses.content: 绝对不可！我们这向罪死了的人，岂可仍在罪中活着？
verses.kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

verses.content: 岂不知我们这浸入基督耶稣的人，是浸入祂的死么？
verses.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death? were: or, are

verses.content: 所以我们借着浸入死，和祂一同埋葬，好叫我们在生命的新样中生活行动，像基督借着父的荣耀，从死人中复活一样。
verses.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

verses.content: 我们若在祂死的样式里与祂联合生长，也必要在祂复活的样式里与祂联合生长；
verses.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

verses.content: 知道我们的旧人已经与祂同钉十字架，使罪的身体失效，叫我们不再作罪的奴仆，
verses.kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

verses.content: 因为已死的人，是已经从罪开释了。
verses.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin. freed: Gr. justified

verses.content: 我们若与基督同死，就信也必与祂同活，
verses.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

verses.content: 知道基督既从死人中复活，就不再死，死也不再作主管辖祂了。
verses.kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

verses.content: 因为祂死，是一次永远地向罪死了；祂活，是向神活着。
verses.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

verses.content: 这样，你们在基督耶稣里，向罪也当算自己是死的，向神却当算自己是活的。
verses.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.content: 所以不要让罪在你们必死的身体里作王，使你们顺从身体的私欲，
verses.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

verses.content: 也不要将你们的肢体献给罪作不义的兵器；倒要像从死人中活过来的人，将自己献给神，并将你们的肢体献给神作义的兵器。
verses.kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God. instruments: Gr. arms, or, weapons

verses.content: 罪必不能作主管辖你们，因你们不在律法之下，乃在恩典之下。
verses.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

verses.content: 这却怎么样？因我们不在律法之下，乃在恩典之下，就可以犯罪么？绝对不可！
verses.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

verses.content: 岂不晓得你们将自己献给谁作奴仆，以至于顺从，就作了你们所顺从者的奴仆么？或作罪的奴仆，以至于死，或作顺从的奴仆，以至于义。
verses.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

verses.content: 感谢神，你们从前虽然作罪的奴仆，现今却从心里顺从了你们被交于其中之教训的规模。
verses.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you. which...: Gr. whereto ye were delivered

verses.content: 你们既从罪里得了释放，就作了义的奴仆。
verses.kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

verses.content: 我因你们肉体的软弱，就照着人的常情说，你们从前怎样将肢体献给不洁不法作奴仆，以至于不法，现今也要照样将肢体献给义作奴仆，以至于圣别。
verses.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

verses.content: 因为你们作罪之奴仆的时候，就不受义的约束。
verses.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness. from...: Gr. to righteousness

verses.content: 那时你们有什么果子？不过是你们现今所看为羞耻的事，那些事的结局就是死。
verses.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

verses.content: 但现今你们既从罪里得了释放，作了神的奴仆，就有圣别的果子，结局就是永远的生命。
verses.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

verses.content: 因为罪的工价乃是死，惟有神的恩赐，在我们的主基督耶稣里，乃是永远的生命。
verses.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.content: 弟兄们，我现在对明白律法的人说，你们岂不知律法作主管辖人，是在他活着的时候么？
verses.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

verses.content: 女人有了丈夫，丈夫还活着，就受律法约束，归与丈夫；丈夫若死了，就脱离了丈夫的律法。
verses.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

verses.content: 所以，丈夫活着，她若归与别的男人，便叫淫妇；丈夫若死了，她就脱离了那律法，虽然归与别的男人，也不是淫妇。
verses.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

verses.content: 我的弟兄们，这样说来，你们借着基督的身体，向着律法也已经是死的了，叫你们归与别人，就是归与那从死人中复活的，使我们结果子给神。
verses.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another,  even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

verses.content: 因为我们在肉体中的时候，那借着律法活动的罪欲，就在我们肢体中发动，以致结果子给死。
verses.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death. motions: Gr. passions

verses.content: 但我们既然在捆我们的律法上死了，现今就脱离了律法，叫我们在灵的新样里服事，不在字句的旧样里。
verses.kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter. that being...: or, being dead to that

verses.content: 这样，我们可说什么？律法是罪么？绝对不是！只是非借律法，我就不知何为罪；非律法说，“不可起贪心，”我就不知何为贪心。
verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet. lust: or, concupiscence

verses.content: 然而罪借着诫命得着机会，叫诸般的贪心在我里面发动，因为没有律法，罪是死的。
verses.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was  dead.

verses.content: 我以前没有律法是活着的，但是诫命来到，罪又活了，我就死了。
verses.kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

verses.content: 那本来叫人得生命的诫命，反倒成了叫我死的；
verses.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

verses.content: 因为罪借着诫命得着机会，诱骗了我，并且借着诫命杀了我。
verses.kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me .

verses.content: 这样看来，律法是圣的，诫命也是圣的、义的并善的。
verses.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

verses.content: 这样，那善的是叫我死么？绝对不是！然而罪为要显出真是罪，就借着那善的叫我死，使罪借着诫命成为极其罪恶的。
verses.kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

verses.content: 我们原晓得律法是属灵的，但我是属肉的，是已经卖给罪了。
verses.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

verses.content: 因为我所行出来的，我不认可；我所愿意的，我并不作；我所恨恶的，我倒去作。
verses.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I. allow: Gr. know

verses.content: 若我所作的，是我所不愿意的，我就同意律法是善的。
verses.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

verses.content: 其实，不是我行出来的，乃是住在我里面的罪行出来的。
verses.kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

verses.content: 我知道住在我里面，就是我肉体之中，并没有善，因为立志为善由得我，只是行出来由不得我。
verses.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

verses.content: 因为我所愿意的善，我反不作；我所不愿意的恶，我倒去作。
verses.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

verses.content: 若我去作所不愿意的，就不是我行出来的，乃是住在我里面的罪行出来的。
verses.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

verses.content: 于是我发现那律与我这愿意为善的人同在，就是那恶与我同在。
verses.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

verses.content: 因为按着里面的人，我是喜欢神的律，
verses.kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

verses.content: 但我看出我肢体中另有个律，和我心思的律交战，借着那在我肢体中罪的律，把我掳去。
verses.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

verses.content: 我是个苦恼的人！谁要救我脱离那属这死的身体？
verses.kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? the body...: or, this body of death

verses.content: 感谢神，借着我们的主耶稣基督！这样看来，我自己用心思服事神的律，却用肉体服事罪的律。
verses.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

verses.content: 如此，现今那些在基督耶稣里的，就没有定罪了。
verses.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

verses.content: 因为生命之灵的律，在基督耶稣里已经释放了我，使我脱离了罪与死的律。
verses.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

verses.content: 律法因肉体而软弱，有所不能的，神，既在罪之肉体的样式里，并为着罪，差来了自己的儿子，就在肉体中定罪了罪，
verses.kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh: for sin: or, by a sacrifice for sin

verses.content: 使律法义的要求，成就在我们这不照着肉体，只照着灵而行的人身上。
verses.kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

verses.content: 因为照着肉体的人，思念肉体的事；照着灵的人，思念那灵的事。
verses.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

verses.content: 因为心思置于肉体，就是死；心思置于灵，乃是生命平安。
verses.kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace. to be carnally...: Gr. the minding of the flesh to be spiritually...: Gr. the minding of the Spirit

verses.content: 因为置于肉体的心思，是与神为仇，因它不服神的律法，也是不能服；
verses.kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be. the carnal...: Gr. the minding of the flesh

verses.content: 而且在肉体里的人，不能得神的喜悦。
verses.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

verses.content: 但神的灵若住在你们里面，你们就不在肉体里，乃在灵里了；然而人若没有基督的灵，就不是属基督的。
verses.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

verses.content: 但基督若在你们里面，身体固然因罪是死的，灵却因义是生命。
verses.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

verses.content: 然而那叫耶稣从死人中复活者的灵，若住在你们里面，那叫基督从死人中复活的，也必借着祂住在你们里面的灵，赐生命给你们必死的身体。
verses.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you. by: or, because of

verses.content: 弟兄们，这样，我们并不是欠肉体的债，去照肉体活着。
verses.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

verses.content: 因为你们若照肉体活着，必要死；但你们若靠着那灵治死身体的行为，必要活着。
verses.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

verses.content: 因为凡被神的灵引导的，都是神的儿子。
verses.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

verses.content: 你们所受的不是奴役的灵，仍旧害怕；所受的乃是儿子名分的灵，在这灵里，我们呼叫：阿爸，父。
verses.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

verses.content: 那灵自己同我们的灵见证我们是神的儿女。
verses.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

verses.content: 既是儿女，便是后嗣，就是神的后嗣，和基督同作后嗣，只要我们与祂一同受苦，好叫我们也与祂一同得荣耀。
verses.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him , that we may be also glorified together.

verses.content: 因为我算定今时的苦楚，不配与将来要显于我们的荣耀相比。
verses.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

verses.content: 受造之物正在专切期望着，热切等待神的众子显示出来。
verses.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

verses.content: 因为受造之物服在虚空之下，不是自己愿意的，乃是因那叫它服的，
verses.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

verses.content: 指望着受造之物自己，也要从败坏的奴役得着释放，得享神儿女之荣耀的自由。
verses.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

verses.content: 我们知道一切受造之物一同叹息，一同受生产之苦，直到如今。
verses.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now. the...: or, every creature

verses.content: 不但如此，就是我们这有那灵作初熟果子的，也是自己里面叹息，热切等待儿子的名分，就是我们的身体得赎。
verses.kjv: And not only they , but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit , the redemption of our body.

verses.content: 因为我们是在盼望中得救的；只是所见的盼望不是盼望，谁还盼望他所见的？
verses.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

verses.content: 但我们若盼望所不见的，就必忍耐着热切等待。
verses.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it .

verses.content: 况且，那灵也照样帮同担负我们的软弱；我们本不晓得当怎样祷告，只是那灵亲自用说不出来的叹息，为我们代求。
verses.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

verses.content: 那鉴察人心的，晓得那灵的意思，因为祂是照着神为圣徒代求。
verses.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God. because: or, that

verses.content: 还有，我们晓得万有都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处，就是按祂旨意被召的人。
verses.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his  purpose.

verses.content: 因为神所预知的人，祂也预定他们模成神儿子的形像，使祂儿子在许多弟兄中作长子。
verses.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

verses.content: 祂所预定的人，又召他们来；所召来的人，又称他们为义；所称为义的人，又叫他们得荣耀。
verses.kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

verses.content: 这样，对这些事，我们可说什么？神若帮助我们，谁能抵挡我们？
verses.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

verses.content: 神既不吝惜自己的儿子，为我们众人舍了，岂不也把万有和祂一同白白地赐给我们么？
verses.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

verses.content: 谁能控告神所拣选的人？有神称我们为义了。
verses.kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.

verses.content: 谁能定我们的罪？有基督耶稣已经死了，而且已经复活了，现今在神的右边，还为我们代求。
verses.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

verses.content: 谁能使我们与基督的爱隔绝？难道是患难么？是困苦么？是逼迫么？是饥饿么？是赤身么？是危险么？是刀剑么？
verses.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

verses.content: 如经上所记：“我们为你的缘故，终日被杀，人看我们如将宰的羊。”
verses.kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.content: 然而借着那爱我们的，在这一切的事上，我们已经得胜有余了。
verses.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

verses.content: 因为我深信，无论是死，是生，是天使，是掌权的，是现今的事，是要来的事，是有能的，
verses.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

verses.content: 是高，是深，或是别的受造之物，都不能叫我们与神的爱隔绝，这爱是在我们的主基督耶稣里的。
verses.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.content: 我在基督里说真话，并不说谎，有我的良心在圣灵里同我作见证，
verses.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

verses.content: 我是大有忧愁，心里不住地伤痛。
verses.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

verses.content: 为我弟兄，我肉身的亲人，我宁愿自己被咒诅，与基督分离。
verses.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh: accursed: or, separated

verses.content: 他们是以色列人，那儿子的名分、荣耀、诸约、律法的颁赐、事奉和应许，都是他们的；
verses.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God , and the promises; covenants: or, testaments

verses.content: 列祖是他们的，按肉体说，基督也是出于他们的，祂是在万有之上，永远受颂赞的神。阿们。
verses.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came , who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

verses.content: 但这不是说，神的话落了空，因为从以色列生的，不都是以色列人；
verses.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

verses.content: 也不因为是亚伯拉罕的后裔，就都是儿女，惟独“从以撒生的，才要称为你的后裔。”
verses.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

verses.content: 这就是说，肉体的儿女不就是神的儿女，惟独那应许的儿女才算是后裔。
verses.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

verses.content: 因为所应许的话是这样：“到明年这时候我要来，撒拉必生一个儿子。”
verses.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

verses.content: 不但如此，还有利百加，既从一个人，就是从我们的祖宗以撒怀了孕，
verses.kjv: And not only this ; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

verses.content: 双子还没有生下来，善恶也没有作出来，（只因要坚定神拣选人的旨意，不是本于行为，乃是本于那呼召人的，）
verses.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

verses.content: 神就对利百加说，“将来大的要服事小的。”
verses.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger. elder: or, greater younger: or, lesser

verses.content: 正如经上所记：“雅各是我所爱的，以扫是我所恨的。”
verses.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

verses.content: 这样，我们可说什么？难道在神有不义么？绝对没有！
verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

verses.content: 因为祂对摩西说，“我要向谁施怜悯，就向谁施怜悯；要对谁动怜恤，就对谁动怜恤。”
verses.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

verses.content: 这样看来，这不在于那定意的，也不在于那奔跑的，只在于那施怜悯的神。
verses.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

verses.content: 因为经上对法老说，“我特意将你兴起来，为要在你身上显示我的权能，并要使我的名传遍全地。”
verses.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

verses.content: 这样看来，神愿意向谁施怜悯，就向谁施怜悯；愿意叫谁刚硬，就叫谁刚硬。
verses.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy , and whom he will he hardeneth.

verses.content: 这样，你必对我说，祂为什么还指责人？有谁抗拒祂的旨意？
verses.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

verses.content: 人哪，你是谁，竟向神顶嘴？被塑造者岂能对塑造他者说，你为什么这样造我？
verses.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it , Why hast thou made me thus? repliest...: or, answerest again, or, disputest with God?

verses.content: 窑匠难道没有权柄，从同一团泥里，拿一块作成贵重的器皿，又拿一块作成卑贱的器皿么？
verses.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

verses.content: 若是神愿意显示祂的忿怒，彰显祂的能力，就多用恒忍宽容那些可怒、预备遭毁灭的器皿，
verses.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction: fitted: or, made up

verses.content: 且要在那些蒙怜悯、早预备得荣耀的器皿上，彰显祂荣耀的丰富；
verses.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

verses.content: 这器皿就是我们这蒙祂所召的，不但从犹太人中，也从外邦人中，这有什么不可？
verses.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

verses.content: 就如神在何西阿书上也说，“那本来不是我子民的，我要称为我的子民；本来不是蒙爱的，我要称为蒙爱的；
verses.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

verses.content: 从前在什么地方对他们说，你们不是我的子民，将来就在那里称他们为活神的儿子。”
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

verses.content: 以赛亚指着以色列人喊着：“以色列子孙的数目虽如海沙，得救的不过是剩下的余数；
verses.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

verses.content: 因为主要在地上实行祂的话，要将祂的话完成且截短。”
verses.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth. the work: or, the account

verses.content: 又如以赛亚先前说过，“若不是万军之主给我们存留余种，我们早已成了所多玛，并像蛾摩拉的样子了。”
verses.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha. Sabaoth: Heb. hosts

verses.content: 这样，我们可说什么？那未曾追求义的外邦人，反得着了义，就是本于信的义。
verses.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

verses.content: 但那追求律法之义的以色列人，并未达到那律法。
verses.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

verses.content: 这是为什么？因为不是本于信，而是本于行。他们正碰跌在那绊脚石上，
verses.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

verses.content: 就如经上所记：“看哪，我在锡安放一块绊脚的石头，并跌人的磐石，信靠祂的，必不至于羞愧。”
verses.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed. ashamed: or confounded

verses.content: 弟兄们，我心里所喜悦的，并我向神为以色列人所祈求的，是要他们得救。
verses.kjv: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

verses.content: 我可以为他们作见证，他们对神有热心，但不是按着完全的知识；
verses.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

verses.content: 因为不知道神的义，又想要建立自己的义，就不服神的义了。
verses.kjv: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

verses.content: 原来律法的总结就是基督，使凡信的都得着义。
verses.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

verses.content: 论到那本于律法的义，摩西写着：“行这些事的，必因这些事活着。”
verses.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

verses.content: 但那本于信的义如此说，“你不要心里说，谁要升到天上？”就是要领下基督来，
verses.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above :)

verses.content: 或说，“谁要下到无底坑？”就是要领基督从死人中上来。
verses.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

verses.content: 这义到底怎么说？它说，“这话与你相近，就在你口里，也在你心里。”这就是我们所传信主的话，
verses.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

verses.content: 就是你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信神叫祂从死人中复活，就必得救；
verses.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

verses.content: 因为人心里信，就得着义；口里承认，就得救。
verses.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

verses.content: 因为经上说，“凡信靠祂的，必不至于羞愧。”
verses.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

verses.content: 因为犹太人和希利尼人并没有分别，众人同有一位主，祂对一切呼求祂的人是丰富的。
verses.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

verses.content: 因为“凡呼求主名的，就必得救。”
verses.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

verses.content: 然而人所未曾信入的，怎能呼求？所未曾听见的，怎能信入？没有传道的，怎能听见？
verses.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

verses.content: 若非奉差遣，怎能传道？如经上所记：“传福音报喜信的人，他们的脚踪何等佳美！”
verses.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

verses.content: 只是人没有都顺从福音，因为以赛亚说，“主啊，我们所传给人听的，有谁信？”
verses.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report? our report: Gr. the hearing of us? report: or, preaching?

verses.content: 可见信是由于听，听是借着基督的话。
verses.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

verses.content: 但我说，他们未曾听见么？的确听见了：“他们的声音传遍全地，他们的言语达到地极。”
verses.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

verses.content: 但我说，以色列人不知道么？先有摩西说，“我要用那不是国民的，惹动你们妒忌；我要用那无知的民，触动你们发怒。”
verses.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

verses.content: 又有以赛亚放胆说，“没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见；没有求问我的，我向他们显现。”
verses.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

verses.content: 至于以色列人，他却说，“我整天向那悖逆顶嘴的百姓伸手招呼。”
verses.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

verses.content: 这样，我说，神弃绝了祂的百姓么？绝对没有！因为我也是以色列人，出于亚伯拉罕的后裔，属便雅悯支派的。
verses.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.content: 神并没有弃绝祂预先所知道的百姓。你们岂不晓得经上论到以利亚是怎么说的？他怎样向神控告以色列人说，
verses.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying, of Elias: Gr. in Elias?

verses.content: “主啊，他们杀了你的申言者，拆了你的祭坛，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。”
verses.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

verses.content: 但神的回话是怎么对他说的？是说，“我为自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的。”
verses.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

verses.content: 在现今的时候，也是这样，照着恩典的拣选，还有剩下的余数。
verses.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

verses.content: 既是照着恩典，就不再是本于行为；不然，恩典就不再是恩典了。
verses.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

verses.content: 这怎么样？以色列人所切求的，他们没有得着，惟有蒙拣选的人得着了，其余的都成了顽梗不化的。
verses.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded blinded: or, hardened

verses.content: 如经上所记：“神给他们昏睡的灵，看不见的眼，听不见的耳，直到今日。”
verses.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day. slumber: or, remorse

verses.content: 大卫也说，“愿他们的筵席成为陷阱，成为网罗，成为绊脚石，作对他们的报应；
verses.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

verses.content: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不能看见；愿你时常弯下他们的脊背。”
verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

verses.content: 这样，我说，他们失脚是要他们跌倒么？绝对不是！反倒因他们的过失，救恩便临到外邦人，好惹动他们妒忌。
verses.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

verses.content: 若他们的过失成为世人的富足，他们的缺乏成为外邦人的富足，何况他们的丰满？
verses.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness? diminishing: or, decay, or, loss

verses.content: 我是对你们外邦人说的，因我是外邦人的使徒，所以荣耀我的职事，
verses.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

verses.content: 或者可以惹动我骨肉之亲妒忌，好救他们一些人。
verses.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

verses.content: 若他们被丢弃，世人就得与神和好，他们被收纳，岂不是从死人中复生么？
verses.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead?

verses.content: 所献面团的头一部分若是圣的，全团也是圣的；树根若是圣的，树枝也是圣的。
verses.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy : and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

verses.content: 若有几根枝子被折下来，你这野橄榄得在其中接上去，一同有分于橄榄根的肥汁，
verses.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree; among them: or, for them

verses.content: 你就不可向那些枝子夸口；纵然夸口，也不是你托着根，乃是根托着你。
verses.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

verses.content: 这样，你要说，那些枝子被折下来，是特为叫我接上去。
verses.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

verses.content: 不错，他们因着不信，所以被折下来，你因着信，所以站立得住。你不可心思高傲，倒要惧怕；
verses.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

verses.content: 因为神若不吝惜本来的枝子，也必不吝惜你。
verses.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

verses.content: 你看神的恩慈和严厉：对那跌倒的人是严厉，对你却是神的恩慈，只要你常留在祂的恩慈中；不然，你也要被砍下来。
verses.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

verses.content: 而且他们若不是常留于不信中，仍要被接上，因为神能够把他们重新接上。
verses.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

verses.content: 你是从那天然的野橄榄树上砍下来的，尚且逆着性得接在栽种的橄榄树上，何况这些天然的枝子，岂不更要接在自己的橄榄树上么？
verses.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches , be graffed into their own olive tree?

verses.content: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道这奥秘，（恐怕你们自以为精明，）就是以色列人有几分硬心，直到外邦人的数目添满了，
verses.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in. blindness: or, hardness

verses.content: 于是以色列全家都要得救，如经上所记：“必有拯救者从锡安出来，祂要从雅各家消除不虔。
verses.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

verses.content: 我除去他们罪的时候，这就是我与他们所立的约。”
verses.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

verses.content: 就着福音说，他们因你们的缘故是仇敌；但就着拣选说，他们因列祖的缘故是蒙爱的。
verses.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.

verses.content: 因为神的恩赐和呼召，是没有后悔的。
verses.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

verses.content: 你们从前不信从神，如今却因他们的不信从，蒙了怜悯；
verses.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief: believed: or, obeyed

verses.content: 照样，他们现今也是不信从的，叫他们因着你们所蒙的怜悯，现今也就蒙怜悯。
verses.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy. believed: or, obeyed

verses.content: 因为神将众人都圈在不信从之中，为要怜悯众人。
verses.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all. concluded...: or, shut them all up together

verses.content: 深哉，神的丰富、智慧和知识！祂的判断何其难测，祂的道路何其难寻！
verses.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

verses.content: 谁曾知道主的心思，谁曾作过祂的策士？
verses.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

verses.content: 谁曾先给了祂，使祂后来偿还？
verses.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

verses.content: 因为万有都是本于祂、借着祂、并归于祂；愿荣耀归与祂，直到永远。阿们。
verses.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen. whom: Gr. him

verses.content: 所以弟兄们，我借着神的怜恤劝你们，将身体献上，当作圣别并讨神喜悦的活祭，这是你们合理的事奉。
verses.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

verses.content: 不要模仿这世代，反要借着心思的更新而变化，叫你们验证何为神那美好、可喜悦、并纯全的旨意。
verses.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

verses.content: 我借着所赐给我的恩典，对你们各人说，不要看自己过于所当看的，乃要照着神所分给各人信心的度量，看得清明适度。
verses.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith. soberly: Gr. to sobriety

verses.content: 正如我们一个身体上有好些肢体，但肢体不都有一样的功用；
verses.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

verses.content: 我们这许多人，在基督里是一个身体，并且各个互相作肢体，也是如此。
verses.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

verses.content: 照着所赐给我们的恩典，我们得了不同的恩赐：或申言，就当照着信心的程度申言；
verses.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy  according to the proportion of faith;

verses.content: 或服事，就当忠于服事；或作教导的，就当忠于教导；
verses.kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

verses.content: 或作劝勉的，就当忠于劝勉；分授的，就当单纯；带领的，就当殷勤；怜悯人的，就当甘心乐意。
verses.kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness. giveth: or, imparteth with simplicity: or, liberally

verses.content: 爱不可假冒，恶要厌弃，善要贴近。
verses.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

verses.content: 爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；恭敬人，要互相争先。
verses.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another; with...: or, in the love of the brethren

verses.content: 殷勤不可懒惰，要灵里火热，常常服事主。
verses.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

verses.content: 在指望中要喜乐，在患难中要忍耐，在祷告上要坚定持续，
verses.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

verses.content: 在圣徒缺乏上要有交通，待客要追寻机会。
verses.kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

verses.content: 逼迫你们的，要为他们祝福；只要祝福，不可咒诅。
verses.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

verses.content: 与喜乐的人要同乐，与哀哭的人要同哭。
verses.kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

verses.content: 要彼此思念相同的事，不要思念高傲的事，倒要俯就卑微的人，不要自以为精明。
verses.kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits. condescend...: or, be contented with mean things

verses.content: 不要以恶报恶，要准备在众人面前作善美的事。
verses.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

verses.content: 若是可能，总要尽力与众人和睦。
verses.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

verses.content: 亲爱的，不要为自己伸冤，宁可给神的忿怒留地步，因为经上记着：“主说，伸冤在我，我必报应。”
verses.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

verses.content: 反而“你的仇敌若饿了，就给他吃，若渴了，就给他喝，因为你这样行，就是把炭火堆在他的头上。”
verses.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

verses.content: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
verses.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.content: 在上有权柄的，人人都当服从，因为没有权柄不是从神来的，凡掌权的都是神所设立的。
verses.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God. ordained: or, ordered

verses.content: 所以抗拒掌权的，就是抗拒神的设立；抗拒的必自招处罚。
verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

verses.content: 作官的原不是叫行善的惧怕，乃是叫作恶的惧怕。你愿意不惧怕掌权的么？你只要行善，就可得他的称赞，
verses.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

verses.content: 因为他是神的仆人，是与你有益的。但你若作恶，就当惧怕，因为他不是徒然佩剑，他是神的仆人，是伸冤的，使忿怒临到那作恶的。
verses.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

verses.content: 所以你们必须服从，不但是因为忿怒，也是因为良心。
verses.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

verses.content: 你们上税也为这缘故，因他们是神的仆役，为这差事专责服役。
verses.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

verses.content: 凡人所当得的，就给他们：当得税的，就给他上税；当得捐的，就给他纳捐；当惧怕的，就惧怕他；当尊敬的，就尊敬他。
verses.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

verses.content: 凡事都不可亏欠人，惟有彼此相爱，要常以为亏欠，因为爱人的就完全了律法。
verses.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

verses.content: 因为“不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪心，”以及任何别的诫命，都总括在“要爱邻舍如同自己”这一句话里面了。
verses.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.content: 爱是不加害与邻舍的，所以爱乃是律法的完满。
verses.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

verses.content: 再者，你们晓得这时期，现在就是你们该睡醒的时刻了，因为我们得救，现今比初信的时候更近了。
verses.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

verses.content: 黑夜已深，白昼将近，所以我们当脱去黑暗的行为，穿上光的兵器。
verses.kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

verses.content: 行事为人要端正得体，好像在白昼；不可荒宴醉酒，不可纵欲淫荡，不可争竞嫉妒；
verses.kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying. honestly: or, decently

verses.content: 总要穿上主耶稣基督，不要为肉体打算，去放纵私欲。
verses.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof .

verses.content: 信心软弱的，你们要接纳，但不是为判断所争论的事。
verses.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations. not...: or, not to judge his doubtful thoughts

verses.content: 有人信百物都可吃，但那软弱的，只吃蔬菜。
verses.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

verses.content: 吃的人不可轻视不吃的人，不吃的人也不可审判吃的人，因为神已经接纳他了。
verses.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

verses.content: 你是谁，竟审判别人的家仆？他或站住或跌倒，自有他的主人在，而且他也必要站住，因为主能使他站住。
verses.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

verses.content: 有人断定这日比那日强，有人断定日日都一样，只是各人自己的心思要坚信不移。
verses.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike . Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind. fully persuaded: or, fully assured

verses.content: 守日的人是向主守的，吃的人是向主吃的，因为他感谢神；不吃的人是向主不吃的，他也感谢神。
verses.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks. regardeth: or, observeth

verses.content: 因为我们没有一个人向自己活，也没有一个人向自己死；
verses.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

verses.content: 我们若活着，是向主活；若死了，是向主死。所以我们或活或死，总是主的人。
verses.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

verses.content: 因此基督死了，又活了，为要作死人并活人的主。
verses.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

verses.content: 你为什么审判你的弟兄？又为什么轻视你的弟兄？我们都要站在神的审判台前，
verses.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

verses.content: 因为经上记着：“主说，我指着我的生存起誓，万膝必向我跪拜，万口也必向神公开承认。”
verses.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

verses.content: 这样看来，我们各人必要将自己的事向神陈明。
verses.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

verses.content: 所以我们不可再彼此审判，宁可这样断定：不给弟兄放下绊脚石或跌人之物。
verses.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.

verses.content: 我在主耶稣里确知深信，凡物本身没有不洁净的，惟独人算为不洁净的，在他就不洁净了。
verses.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean. unclean: Gr. common

verses.content: 你若因食物叫弟兄忧愁，就不再是照着爱而行。基督已经替他死了，你不可因你的食物败坏他。
verses.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died. charitably: Gr. according to charity

verses.content: 所以，不可叫你们的善被人毁谤，
verses.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

verses.content: 因为神的国不在于吃喝，乃在于公义、和平、并圣灵中的喜乐。
verses.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

verses.content: 这样服事基督的，就为神所喜悦，又为人所称许。
verses.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

verses.content: 所以我们务要追求和平的事，以及彼此建造的事。
verses.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

verses.content: 不可因食物拆毁神的工程。凡物固然洁净，但人吃了，以致成了绊脚石，就是他的恶了。
verses.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

verses.content: 无论是吃肉，是喝酒，或是什么别的绊跌你弟兄的事，一概不作才好。
verses.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

verses.content: 你有信心，就当自己在神面前持守。人在自己所称许的事上，不审判自己，就有福了。
verses.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

verses.content: 但那疑惑的人若吃了，就必被定罪，因为不是出于信心。凡不是出于信心的，都是罪。
verses.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin. doubteth: or, discerneth and putteth a difference between meats damned: or, condemned, or liable to punishment

verses.content: 我们刚强的人，应该担代不刚强之人的软弱，不求自己的喜悦。
verses.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

verses.content: 我们各人要叫邻舍喜悦，使他得益处，被建造。
verses.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

verses.content: 因为基督也不求自己的喜悦，反而如经上所记：“辱骂你之人的辱骂，都落在我身上。”
verses.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

verses.content: 从前所写的，都是为教训我们写的，使我们借着忍耐，并借着经书的鼓励，可以得着盼望。
verses.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

verses.content: 但愿那赐忍耐与鼓励的神，叫你们照着基督耶稣，彼此思念相同的事，
verses.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus: according to: or, after the example of

verses.content: 使你们同心合意，用同一的口，荣耀我们主耶稣基督的神与父。
verses.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.content: 所以你们要彼此接纳，如同基督接纳你们一样，使荣耀归与神。
verses.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

verses.content: 我说，基督是为神的真实，作了受割礼之人的执事，要证实对列祖的应许，
verses.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

verses.content: 并叫外邦人，因着神的怜悯荣耀神，如经上所记：“因此我要在外邦中颂扬你，歌颂你的名。”
verses.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

verses.content: 又说，“外邦人啊，你们当与祂的百姓一同快乐。”
verses.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

verses.content: 又说，“万邦啊，你们都当赞美主，愿万民都称赞祂。”
verses.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

verses.content: 又有以赛亚说，“将来有耶西的根，就是那兴起来要治理外邦的，外邦人都要寄望于祂。”
verses.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

verses.content: 但愿那赐盼望的神，因信将一切喜乐平安充满你们，使你们靠圣灵的能力，充盈满溢地有盼望。
verses.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

verses.content: 我的弟兄们，我自己也深信你们是满有良善，充满了各样的知识，也能彼此劝戒。
verses.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

verses.content: 但在有些点上，我更加放胆地写给你们，是要提醒你们，特因神所赐我的恩典，
verses.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

verses.content: 使我为外邦人作基督耶稣的仆役，作神福音勤奋的祭司，叫所献上的外邦人，在圣灵里得以圣别，可蒙悦纳。
verses.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost. offering up: or, sacrificing

verses.content: 所以论到神的事，我在基督耶稣里有可夸的。
verses.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

verses.content: 除了基督借我作成的那些事，我什么都不敢提，只提祂借着我的言语和行为，用神迹奇事的能力，并那灵的能力，使外邦人顺从；
verses.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

verses.content: 这样，我从耶路撒冷，直转到以利哩古，到处传了基督的福音。
verses.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

verses.content: 我立定志向，不在基督的名被称过的地方传福音，免得建造在别人的根基上，
verses.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:

verses.content: 就如经上所记：“未曾得知祂信息的，将要看见；未曾听过的，将要领悟。”
verses.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

verses.content: 因此，我也多次被拦阻，总不得到你们那里去。
verses.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you. much: or, many ways, or oftentimes

verses.content: 但如今这一带地方已无处可传，而且多年来我一直想望，当我去西班牙的时候，可以到你们那里，
verses.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

verses.content: 盼望从你们那里经过，得见你们，先与你们交往，稍得满足，然后蒙你们送行到那里去。
verses.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company . with...: Gr. with you

verses.content: 但现在我往耶路撒冷去，供给圣徒。
verses.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

verses.content: 因为马其顿和亚该亚人，乐意对耶路撒冷圣徒中的穷人有些交通。
verses.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

verses.content: 这是他们乐意的，其实也是他们所欠的债。因外邦人既然分享犹太人属灵的事物，就当供给他们肉身之物。
verses.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

verses.content: 等我办完了这事，把这果子向他们交付妥当，就要路过你们那里，往西班牙去。
verses.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

verses.content: 我也晓得，我去的时候，必带着基督之福的丰满而去。
verses.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

verses.content: 弟兄们，我借着我们的主耶稣基督，并借着那灵的爱，恳求你们在为我向神的祷告中，与我一同竭力，
verses.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

verses.content: 叫我可以得救，脱离犹太地不信从的人，也叫我对耶路撒冷的服事，可蒙圣徒悦纳，
verses.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have  for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints; do not...: or, are disobedient

verses.content: 并叫我借着神的旨意，欢欢喜喜地到你们那里，与你们同得安息畅快。
verses.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

verses.content: 愿平安的神与你们众人同在。阿们。
verses.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

verses.content: 我向你们推荐我们的姊妹非比，她是在坚革哩的召会的女执事，
verses.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

verses.content: 请你们在主里面照着与圣徒相配的接待她。她在何事上需要你们，你们就辅助她，因她素来护助许多人，也护助了我。
verses.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

verses.content: 问我在基督耶稣里的同工，百基拉和亚居拉安；
verses.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

verses.content: 他们为我的性命，将自己的颈项置于度外，不但我感谢他们，就是外邦的众召会也感谢他们；
verses.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

verses.content: 又问在他们家中的召会安。问我所亲爱的以拜尼土安，他是亚西亚归基督初结的果子。
verses.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

verses.content: 问为你们多多劳苦的马利亚安。
verses.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

verses.content: 问我亲属与我一同坐监的安多尼古和犹尼亚安，他们是使徒中著名的，且比我先在基督里。
verses.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

verses.content: 问我在主里所亲爱的暗伯利安。
verses.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

verses.content: 问我们在基督里的同工耳巴奴，并我所亲爱的士大古安。
verses.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

verses.content: 问在基督里经过试验而蒙称许的亚比利安。问那些属于亚利多布的人安。
verses.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household . household: or, friends

verses.content: 问我亲属希罗天安。问那些属于拿其数，在主里的人安。
verses.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord. household: or, friends

verses.content: 问在主里劳苦的土非拿氏和土富撒氏安。问可亲爱在主里多受劳苦的彼息氏安。
verses.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

verses.content: 问在主里蒙拣选的鲁孚和他母亲，也就是我的母亲安。
verses.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

verses.content: 问亚逊其土，弗勒干，黑米，八罗巴，黑马，并与他们同在的弟兄们安。
verses.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

verses.content: 问非罗罗古和犹利亚，尼利亚和他姊妹，同阿林巴，并与他们同在的众圣徒安。
verses.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

verses.content: 你们要用圣别的亲嘴彼此问安。基督的众召会都问你们安。
verses.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

verses.content: 弟兄们，那些造成分立和绊跌之事，违反你们所学之教训的人，我恳求你们要留意，并要避开他们。
verses.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

verses.content: 因为这样的人不服事我们的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，且用花言巧语，诱骗那些老实人的心。
verses.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

verses.content: 你们的顺从已经传于众人，所以我为你们欢乐，不过我还愿意你们在善上智慧，在恶上单纯。
verses.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil. simple: or, harmless

verses.content: 平安的神快要将撒但践踏在你们的脚下。愿我们主耶稣的恩，与你们同在。
verses.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen. bruise: or, tread

verses.content: 我的同工提摩太，并我的亲属路求，耶孙和所西巴德，问你们安。
verses.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

verses.content: 我这代笔写信的德丢，在主里问你们安。
verses.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

verses.content: 那接待我，也接待全召会的该犹，问你们安。本城的司库以拉都和弟兄括土，问你们安。
verses.kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

verses.content: 神能照我的福音，就是关于耶稣基督的传扬，照历世以来密而不宣之奥秘的启示，坚固你们；
verses.kjv: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

verses.content: 这奥秘如今显明出来，且照永远之神的命令，借着众申言者所写的，指示万国，使他们顺从信仰。
verses.kjv: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

verses.content: 愿荣耀借着耶稣基督，归与这位独一、智慧的神，直到永永远远。阿们。
verses.kjv: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen. Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.
